counterfactual_missing_items: Discoid plaques with scarring and follicular plugging
decisive_items: Positive: anti-Smith antibodies, SSA/Ro antibodies, SSB/La antibodies, and anti-U1RNP antibodies
response.rationale: R2 (SLE) is champion because it uniquely explains the systemic features (proteinuria, hypocomplementemia, anemia) and the highly specific anti-Smith antibody, which are major criteria for SLE. R1 (SCLE) shares the annular plaques and anti-Ro/La but lacks the renal and hematologic involvement and anti-Smith specificity. R3 (DLE) is limited to skin and histopathology, missing the systemic and serologic evidence. The histopathology is compatible with lupus but not specific to DLE.

rejected.why: Fails to account for systemic symptoms, proteinuria, hypocomplementemia, and anti-Smith antibodies; skin lesions are not typical discoid plaques with scarring.
